subject: SIG intake: PR sampling, CI telemetry and change-history export
messages:
From: Bethany Cole <bethany@brightshield.io>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Cc: BrightShield Assessments <assessments@brightshield.io>
Date: 2029-05-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: SIG intake: requested artifacts for SDLC controls

Hi Priya,

Thanks for taking this intake. As part of BrightShield's SIG assessment for Redwood Inference we need a compact package that demonstrates your secure SDLC controls related to PR approvals, CI/CD telemetry, secrets rotation, and change management for the last 12 months. To keep this scoped we are requesting:

- A PR sampling file (CSV) showing PR IDs, author, approver(s), team, and merge timestamp for a representative sample (we typically ask for ~200 PRs or representative sampling by team).
- CI/CD runner telemetry (aggregate logs) showing job start/end, runner id, queue times, and artifact upload events for the same sample window.
- Change-history export (chronology of change approvals / rollouts) covering 2028.
- A brief PDF summarizing secrets rotation policy and evidence of rotation events (key IDs, rotation dates, KMS references).

Can you confirm you can deliver redacted artifacts (we will accept Drive links with a redaction notes file) and let us know estimated delivery (we usually need this within 3 business days to keep the SIG schedule). A couple clarifying questions: do ephemeral CI runners include a machine identifier in logs; and can you provide a mapping of PR approvers to teams?

Best,
Bethany
Bethany Cole
Principal Assessor, BrightShield
bethany@brightshield.io

[Attachment: assessment-request-form.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Bethany Cole <bethany@brightshield.io>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2029-05-05T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG intake: requested artifacts for SDLC controls

Hi Bethany,

We can provide a scoped package. Thanks for the clear list — that helps. Proposed plan and timeline:

- Today: share an index (Drive folder) with redaction notes and the PR sample CSV (anonymized author emails replaced with internal IDs).
- Tomorrow: upload CI runner telemetry aggregate log (redacted of any IPs and ephemeral hostnames) and change-history export (ndjson).
- End of day tomorrow: secrets rotation summary PDF and a short mapping of PR approver -> team.

Short answers to your questions: ephemeral CI runners do include a short runner id (UUID) in the telemetry; we will include a mapping that indicates which runner pools are ephemeral vs persistent. PR approver mapping is available but we need to redact personal emails for the public folder; we'll include internal handle -> team mapping and a redaction-notes file.

I've created a shared folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0A_shared/SIG-intake-2029 (access set to BrightShield assessors). We will attach the following artifact stubs in the folder and provide the download links in the next message: pr-approver-sample-2028.csv, ci-runner-telemetry-2028-aggregate.log, change-history-202801-202812.ndjson, secrets-rotation-summary-2028.pdf.

I'll coordinate with Irene for the change-history provenance and with Lauren for the PR sampling. Target delivery by EOD 2029-05-06 PT. If you need anything sooner or a narrower sample, tell us which teams to prioritize.

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Head of Trust & Compliance (acting)
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: initial-index.txt (text/plain)]

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2029-05-05T12:46:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG intake: requested artifacts for SDLC controls

Priya / Lauren,

One implementation note for the artifacts: please include commit SHAs for all sampled merges and a short redaction-notes.txt that lists what was redacted and why (names -> handles mapping stored in internal vault only). For change-history we should provide both the human-facing change description and the automated deploy event id (so the assessor can correlate PR -> deploy). I will extract the deploy provenance from CI tracer and drop the ndjson into the folder.

I'll also add a brief readme.md with field definitions so the assessor can parse the ndjson easily (fields: timestamp, change_id, pr_id, deploy_id, author_handle, approver_handle, target_env, rollback_flag).

Irene
Irene Choi, Sr. Engineering Manager

[Attachment: provenance-query.sql (text/plain)]

From: Bethany Cole <bethany@brightshield.io>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Cc: BrightShield Assessments <assessments@brightshield.io>
Date: 2029-05-06T08:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG intake: requested artifacts for SDLC controls

Thanks — that timeline works. Two quick clarifications before you upload:

1) For PR approvers: can you provide the approver -> team CSV with columns: approver_handle, team_name, approver_role (peer/techlead/manager)? We use that to validate segregation of duties.
2) For CI telemetry: we will need timestamps in RFC3339 and an indication of retention window for runner logs (how long you retain per-runner telemetry in your telemetry store).

If you prefer, we can accept a partial upload (PR sample + redaction notes) now and the other artifacts later, but please flag anything that cannot be shared due to confidentiality.

-Bethany

[Quoted text from Priya's 2029-05-05 11:04:00 message]
> I've created a shared folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0A_shared/SIG-intake-2029 (access set to BrightShield assessors).
> We will attach the following artifact stubs in the folder and provide the download links in the next message: pr-approver-sample-2028.csv, ci-runner-telemetry-2028-aggregate.log, change-history-202801-202812.ndjson, secrets-rotation-summary-2028.pdf.

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Bethany Cole <bethany@brightshield.io>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2029-05-07T15:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG intake: requested artifacts for SDLC controls

Hi Bethany — upload complete and notes below. Thank you for the quick turn.

Uploaded artifacts (shared folder): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0A_shared/SIG-intake-2029
Attached files (redacted where applicable):
- pr-approver-sample-2028.csv (CSV columns: pr_id, merged_at (RFC3339), commit_sha, author_handle, approver_handle, team_name, approver_role)
- ci-runner-telemetry-2028-aggregate.log (lines redacted for IPs; includes runner_uuid, job_id, started_at, finished_at, queue_ms, artifact_upload_event)
- change-history-202801-202812.ndjson (each line = JSON change event; fields documented in readme.md)
- secrets-rotation-summary-2028.pdf (policy excerpt + table of rotation events with KMS key references)
- redaction-notes-20290505.txt (documents what was redacted and where the full mapping is stored)
- pr-approver-team-map-2028.csv (approver_handle,team_name,approver_role)
- redaction-exceptions.txt (list of items we withheld due to contractual constraints)

Answers to your clarifying Qs:
- Ephemeral runner ids: yes, telemetry includes a runner_uuid; those UUIDs are not resolvable to hostnames in the public export. We indicate in the readme which runner pools were ephemeral.
- Retention window: runner telemetry (detailed per-runner logs) retained for 90 days in hot storage, aggregated telemetry retained for 2 years; we have exported aggregate logs for your timeframe.
- PR approver mapping: included as pr-approver-team-map-2028.csv; approver_role values are peer/techlead/manager.

If you need additional fields (e.g., fuller artifact traces or a signed attestation) let us know and we can scope a follow-up.

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Head of Trust & Compliance (acting)
Redwood Inference
priya_natarajan@redwood.ai

[Attachments uploaded: pr-approver-sample-2028.csv, pr-approver-team-map-2028.csv, ci-runner-telemetry-2028-aggregate.log, change-history-202801-202812.ndjson, secrets-rotation-summary-2028.pdf, redaction-notes-20290505.txt, redaction-exceptions.txt]
